testing_methodology: Pipeline simulation: export_result.sh + verifier.py run against manually-crafted XML files / result JSONs that simulate expected agent output. These are NOT actual agent run scores.

create_portfolio.notes: Pipeline test: simulated output XML with portfolio name, USD currency, securities account, and cash account. Agent would create from scratch via PP wizard.

record_buy_transaction.notes: Pipeline test: simulated crossEntry BUY transaction in XML. Actual agent scoring depends on GUI interaction quality. Export script accumulates txns across all portfolio elements.

add_security_and_buy.notes: Pipeline test: simulated GOOGL security addition + BUY. 95/100 because ISIN/ticker bonus scored partially.

import_historical_quotes.notes: Pipeline test: simulated 125 AAPL price entries in XML. No crossEntry complications.

export_portfolio_csv.notes: Pipeline test: simulated CSV output with Date/Type/Value columns. Supports both English and German locale column names.

reconcile_brokerage_statement.notes: Pipeline test: simulated GOOGL BUY (15 shares, $2,122.35) + AAPL SELL (3 shares, $566.55) + $15,000 deposit added to pre-seeded portfolio with 2 existing transactions.

record_quarterly_dividends.notes: Pipeline test: simulated AAPL Q1 2024 dividend $36.00 (Feb 15) + MSFT Q1 2024 dividend $56.25 (Mar 14), both linked to securities. Real dividend amounts from official announcements.

correct_erroneous_transactions.notes: Pipeline test: Error 1 = AAPL amount corrected from $4,500 to $1,811.80 (10 shares x $181.18 real price). Error 2 = MSFT shares corrected from 50 to 5 (consistent with $390.73/share). Both errors are independently verifiable against historical price data in the XML.

add_security_with_price_history.notes: Pipeline test: simulated Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL, ISIN US02079K3059) added as 3rd security with 30 historical price entries imported from googl_historical_quotes.csv. BUY of 20 shares on 2024-02-01 at $141.49.

export_securities_transactions.notes: Pipeline test: simulated portfolio_trades.csv with 6 data rows (3 AAPL trades + 3 MSFT trades, mix of BUY/SELL), 7 columns. Pass requires both AAPL and MSFT present in CSV.

key_findings.crossEntry_format: PP v0.81.5 uses XStream crossEntry class='buysell' for BUY/SELL transactions. The real portfolio lives inside account-transaction/crossEntry/portfolio, while <portfolios> contains only a reference.
key_findings.xml_version: Must use version 68 (not 71) for compatibility with v0.81.5
key_findings.file_opening: PP ignores command-line file arguments. Must use Ctrl+O > Ctrl+L > type path > Enter
key_findings.portfolio_iteration_fix: root.iter('portfolio') finds both real and reference portfolios. Must accumulate txns with extend(), not overwrite.
key_findings.security_iter_bug: root.iter('security') also matches <security reference='...'> inside transactions. Use root.find('securities').findall('security') instead.
key_findings.dividends_type: Dividend income transactions use type=DIVIDENDS (with 's') in PP XML account-transactions.
key_findings.new_task_testing: New 5 tasks validated via test_new_tasks_pipeline.py (mock copy_from_env). All verifiers pass do-nothing=0, partial<pass_threshold, full>=pass_threshold.
